session_note: Connecticut's 2026 regular session (an even-year, short session) convened 2026-02-04 and adjourned sine die on 2026-05-06, confirmed directly from the House Journal for that date ('the House adjourned at 12:00 o'clock a.m., sine die'). A separate constitutionally mandated veto session convened for one day on 2026-06-15 but did not take up any bill that had not already passed both chambers. Connecticut regular-session bills do NOT carry over: each regular session (2024, 2025, 2026) is a distinct bill universe, and any bill not enacted by that session's sine die adjournment is dead and would require reintroduction as a new bill number in a later session. The 2025 regular session sine die date (2025-06-04) and the 2024 regular session sine die date (2024-05-08) were independently confirmed the same way from the corresponding House Journals, each explicitly labeled the 'final day' / 'last day' of that session.
